biggest_catch: You cannot earn a dollar until you pay: Voices.com's own talent page says a free Guest membership can only receive private invites, and you must upgrade to Premium to respond to posted jobs or create talent packages — Premium is the gate between you and every booking.
catches: Guest (free) membership cannot respond to job postings or create packages; only private invites from clients reach you.

Premium membership is required to respond to jobs and build packages; the official promo page showed $249/year with promo code BF25DEAL (a dated Black Friday promo — confirm current pricing in-account).

All quoted pay figures ($70 telephone to $600 TV ad packages) are client-facing package prices; your take-home depends on the package scope you negotiate and whether the job is self-serve or managed-service.
High competition on a large established marketplace; no guaranteed volume of jobs.
For managed-service jobs the platform may take a commission — the amount is not stated on the pages reviewed.
'Keep every dollar' applies to covered PayPal fees on SurePay transactions; it does not promise fixed per-project pay.

c1.evidence: Voices.com — real operating voice-over marketplace; official talent workflow page (voices.com/talent/how-it-works) and official Packages page.

c2.evidence: Official Packages page lists concrete per-project package prices talent can offer: Telephone $70, Internet Video $100, Radio Ad $150, Narration $200, IVR $350, Television Ad $600. Official workflow: talent may 'quote yourself an hour rate or lump sum.' Official: 'We cover PayPal fees for you, so you keep every dollar you earn.'

c3.evidence: Official talent page: Guest membership is free, but earning requires upgrading to Premium (official promo page priced a year at $249 with code BF25DEAL). This is a real participation cost.

c4.evidence: Official SurePay protection covers payment on completed work; PayPal fees covered by Voices.com. Exact payout timing not published on the reviewed pages.

steps: Go to https://www.voices.com/talent/how-it-works and sign up (Guest membership is free).
Upgrade to Premium membership — required to respond to job postings and create talent packages.
Complete your profile with demos, languages, and accents.
Create talent packages (official examples: Telephone $70, Narration $200, TV Ad $600) or quote your own hourly or lump-sum rate per the official workflow.
Audition for and complete jobs; payment is protected by SurePay and Voices.com covers the PayPal fees.
